name: @midnightntwrk/k-rust-wasm
description: Portable WebAssembly and TypeScript bindings for the k-rust frontend

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:typescript
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:wasm:dev && npm run build:typescript
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir generated --out-name bindings && node scripts/prepare-generated.mjs
scripts.build:wasm:dev: wasm-pack build --dev --target web --out-dir generated --out-name bindings && node scripts/prepare-generated.mjs
